title_en: I sold. Why isn't the money in my bank?
title_zh: 卖出以后，钱为什么没到银行卡？
goal_en: Tell apart selling an asset, getting a stablecoin or fiat balance, and an actual bank withdrawal.
goal_zh: 区分卖出资产、获得稳定币或法币余额，以及实际银行提现。

shots.visual_en: After selling, Sam refreshes a banking app; the bank balance doesn't move.
shots.visual_zh: 小白卖出后刷新银行应用，银行余额不动。

lines.en: I definitely sold. So why hasn't my bank got the money?
lines.zh: 我明明卖了，银行卡怎么还没收到钱？

shots.visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S1 · E08' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第1季 · 第08集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。
onscreen_text_en: I sold. Why isn't the money in my bank?
onscreen_text_zh: 卖出以后，钱为什么没到银行卡？

shots.visual_en: Starting from last episode's 0.002 BTC, an arrow points to a USDT balance, not to the bank.
shots.visual_zh: 从上一集0.002 BTC开始，箭头指向USDT余额，而不是银行。

lines.en: Check which pair you sold into. If you sold for USDT, you got a USDT balance, not money in the bank. Selling and withdrawing to your bank are two separate steps.
lines.zh: 先看你卖给了哪个交易对。如果卖成泰达币，得到的是泰达币余额，不是银行到账。卖出和法币提现，是两个步骤。

shots.visual_en: Teaching sell price 55,000; proceeds 110; assumed fee 0.11; net 109.89.

lines.en: Same teaching example. You sell 0.002 bitcoin at 55,000. That's 110. Take off an assumed fee of 0.11, and 109.89 lands in your account.
lines.zh: 沿用教学例子，零点零零二枚按五万五千卖出，成交金额一百一十；扣假设费用零点一一，到账一百零九点八九。

onscreen_text_en: Teaching assumption · not a live price or real platform rate
onscreen_text_zh: 教学假设 · 非实时行情，非平台真实费率

shots.visual_en: Buy total 100.10 and sell net 109.89 side by side; difference 9.79. USDT balance now 1,009.79.
shots.visual_zh: 买入总支出100.10与卖出净到账109.89并排，差额9.79。

lines.en: Take off the costs. Here it's 9.79, before any currency conversion or withdrawal fees. A price going up isn't the same as your final net gain.
lines.zh: 还要扣成本。这里是九点七九，尚未计算法币兑换、提现等可能的费用。币价涨跌并不等于最终净收益。

onscreen_text_zh: 未计法币兑换和提现费用

shots.visual_en: Supported fiat conversion and withdrawal to your own bank account; status goes Requested → Processing → Arrived.
shots.visual_zh: 平台支持的法币兑换与本人银行提现流程；状态为申请、处理中、到账。

lines.en: If you need the money back in your bank, first check that your region supports it. Then convert or withdraw through the official route to an account in your own name. Check the name, the amount received, the fees and the processing conditions.
lines.zh: 需要转回银行时，先查你所在地区是否支持，再按官方路径兑换或提现到符合要求的本人账户。核对姓名、到账金额、费用和预计处理条件。

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'Your USDT balance went up. Does that mean your bank has received the money?'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：USDT余额增加，是否代表银行已经到账？

lines.en: Keep your trade and withdrawal records. If you're not sure what kind of balance it is, don't decide based on one 'success' message.
lines.zh: 保留交易和提现记录；不确定资金性质，就不要根据一个“成功”提示作判断。

onscreen_text_zh: USDT增加 = 银行到账？ 不是

shots.visual_en: End hook (4 s): quick teaser of the next problem — a single striking image from the next episode's opening, frozen on the moment of doubt; Sam reacts, Nexubo's antenna blinks amber. Text card with the hook line.
shots.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

lines.en: One cheaper network. One wrong click. Your coins may never arrive. Next: the checks you never guess.
lines.zh: 便宜一点的网络，点错一下，币就可能找不回。下一集：转账前一个也别猜。

onscreen_text_en: One cheaper network. One wrong click. Your coins may never arrive. Next: the checks you never guess.
onscreen_text_zh: 便宜一点的网络，点错一下，币就可能找不回。下一集：转账前一个也别猜。

shots.visual_en: Branded close (4 s): logo mark + wordmark lockup, series name, tagline 'Understand first, then act.', small slogan line 'One verified gateway to the world's exchanges', 'nexualpha.com' as plain text (the clickable entry lives on the web page). Nexubo waves, antenna green.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。
onscreen_text_en: One verified gateway to the world's exchanges
onscreen_text_zh: 全球交易所，一个官方入口

end_hook.en: One cheaper network. One wrong click. Your coins may never arrive. Next: the checks you never guess.
end_hook.zh: 便宜一点的网络，点错一下，币就可能找不回。下一集：转账前一个也别猜。

page_cta.line_en: Withdrawal routes and fees differ by exchange and region. Compare them on NexuAlpha.
page_cta.line_zh: 各交易所、各地区的提现路径和费用不同，到 NexuAlpha 对比页查看。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson

exercise.task_en: Complete a practice sell, then mark on the money-flow diagram which step is the bank withdrawal.
exercise.task_zh: 完成模拟卖出，并在资产流向图中标明哪一步才是银行提现。
exercise.answer_en: Selling to USDT is not a bank withdrawal. Net trading result in this example: 9.79.
exercise.answer_zh: 卖出到USDT不等于银行提现；本例净交易盈亏9.79。

red_lines: Never promise fiat withdrawal is always available or has a fixed arrival time ｜ 不承诺法币提现必然可用或固定到账时间
When something goes wrong, use official support; never teach how to get around bank risk controls ｜ 异常时走官方核查，不教规避银行风控
Logo mark + wordmark top-left on every shot, official SVG only ｜ 每个镜头左上角都有正式标志图形＋文字标，只用原始SVG
